karate-js: a stack overflow becomes the RangeError at the first seam with stack headroom. The conversion ran at the deepest frame, where the JS catch that follows did first-use work on an exhausted stack: a class init that overflows is a NoClassDefFoundError and an invokedynamic site whose first link overflows a BootstrapMethodError for the life of the JVM (karate.set's KarateJsUtils init reaching JsonPath DefaultsImpl killed the run inside the report write; Terms$1, the literal switch map, broke every later error; karate.prettyXml's Encodings below karate.map). JsErrorException.stackExceeded(StackOverflowError) answers only when a 650-level probe (~94 KB compiled, 144 B a level, 2.2x the largest measured first-use need of 43 KB for a class init pulling in JsonPath, Logback or the XML encodings; an indy link needs < 14 KB; ~2.7x interpreted) fits, otherwise rethrows the raw error to the next seam (bindArgsAndExecute, evalStatement), re-probing every 16 seams since a failed probe costs an SOE with its trace. The frames between are cut: a raw Error passes every catch (Exception), so a JS catch there does not fire and neither does a JS finally (as for a host cancel); the listener's onError and the interceptor's afterExecute fire at the converting statement. A host built-in calling back into JS from inside an eval (karate.map, fn.call(null, ...)) is not a boundary: JsFunctionNode.call lets the raw error pass to the next JS seam out. A true boundary converts unconditionally, with no headroom guarantee: Engine.evalScoped and a host call from outside any eval to an EngineException named RangeError, AsyncActivation.runBody to a rejection (GeneratorActivation.run already did). karate-js compiles with -XDstringConcat=inline (271 indy concat sites gone, perf-neutral). Rejected: a JS-depth count (blind to the headroom a recursive built-in's unwound Java frames leave, so a catch around JSON.stringify would not fire) and a fresh-thread conversion (protects the conversion, not the catch body). Fresh-JVM harness on 1cf08fe4a -> after: deepKarate (karate-core, karate.set in a deep catch) 40/40 wrong and poisoned -> 0/40; catchStack 25/40 -> 0/40, catchBuiltins 13/40 -> 0/40; mapXml (karate.prettyXml below karate.map) 12/12 -> 0/40 with mapCsv, mapXpath, forEachXml, directXml 0/40; 22 other shapes 0/40. Failing first: EngineExceptionTest.testDeepCatchOfRunawayRecursionDoesNotBreakLaterErrors (e.stack + JSON.stringify in the catch: Terms$1 NoClassDefFoundError), testHandlersBelowTheConvertingFrameAreCut (the cut is > 4 frames, one finally per frame from the catching one out), RunawayRecursionTest (6 fresh JVMs each through Runner, HTML report written, a TypeError after: NoClassDefFoundError DefaultsImpl for karate.set; CharsetProvider for karate.prettyXml below karate.map, which converted at the host call with 5-103 probe levels); testHandlersGetStackHeadroomWhateverPathTheOverflowTook measures the levels delivered to the catch, onError and afterExecute (direct, host callback, getter, toString, generator, async, JSON: 655-717) and asserts >= 600; testAsyncBodyOverflowRejectsWithARangeError. The 200-depth sweep test 2.2 s -> 5.9 s (54 s before the probe spacing). Gates: test262 test/language/** 8168 -> 8168 pass, 0 PASS->FAIL; EngineBenchmark HEAD x2 vs change x4: array 2.88/2.78 -> 3.06/2.74/3.03/3.23 ms, object 1.34/1.36 -> 1.35/1.40/1.43/1.35 ms; karate-js -Pcicd 1887/0/0 (2 skipped), karate-core -Pcicd 3223/0/0 (4 skipped) after a rerun of SuiteCancelTest.aCancelAfterAnAbortOnFailureStillEnumeratesEveryScenario, which fails 3/32 today on a scheduling race of its own (two threads can finish second.feature's 300 ms scenarios before first.feature's failure fires the trigger, so nothing is left to cancel); SuiteCancelTest + IdeEventProfileTest 10x 19/0 then 29/31 on that one test.
